title: Supported finite dual transitions and the degree-zero unit
statement: Under the hypotheses of [def-pur-principal-koszul-dual-terms], its explicit isomorphisms c_m^q intertwine the principal cone successor transition and the strict dual singleton successor transition for q=0 and q=-1. In addition the degree-zero component of the cone inclusion R[0] -> Q_m followed by c_m^0 is the specified ringedKoszulDualUnit in degree zero. These are only equations for fixed, explicitly constructed graded maps; no chain isomorphism, tensor coefficient complex, tower isomorphism or transposition is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0A0E, proof of lemma-derived-completion-koszul, identification of the dual positive Koszul complex with the negative Koszul complex; singleton calculation in the parent proof step 1.

proof.text: Use naturality of the total-tensor right unitor to remove the positive diagram's constant unit, including its forward map. That map is (1,a) in degrees (0,1). The Hom product projection formula makes its dual (a,1) in degrees (-1,0); evaluation at one identifies precomposition by a with multiplication by a. The principal cone transition has these same entries by the mapping-cone map formula. Conjugate by c_m to obtain the two displayed transition equations. For the unit, the positive projection is identity in degree zero, so its dual takes r to the functional with value r at one. This is exactly inverse evaluation in ringedKoszulDualUnit and the degree-zero cone inclusion under c_m. Naturality of the right unitor and equality of the two unit constraints on the tensor unit identify the singleton tensor projection. Zero rings, zero or invertible a and empty sites satisfy the same formulas. The private proved scalar-transposition calculation in the differential module is reused; the differential theorem itself is not assumed to establish the transition and unit equations.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteDualTerm_transition_unit :
    (∀ (m : ℕ) (q : ℤ), q = 0 ∨ q = -1 →
      (principalKoszulTransition R a m).f q ≫ (finiteDualTerm R a m q).hom =
        (finiteDualTerm R a (m + 1) q).hom ≫
          ((ringedKoszulDualTower R 1 (fun _ ↦ ⟨a.val, a.property⟩)).map
            (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ m)).op).f q) ∧
    (∀ m : ℕ, (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr (scalarComplex R a m)).f 0 ≫
        (finiteDualTerm R a m 0).hom =
      (ringedKoszulDualUnit R 1 (fun _ ↦ ⟨a.val, a.property⟩) m).f 0)
